description: Patch one owned Inventory item by inventory_id or nickname (one active match, else candidates and nothing changes). Omitted stay; specs merge per key (null removes); state adds an observation. Never store device/account IDs. ($0.10; API key required)

acquired_date.description: Date acquired YYYY-MM-DD (gift, inheritance). Fills purchase_date.

acquired_from.description: Purchased from: shop or person it came from. Never treated as storage location.

category.description: Category, e.g. electronics. Default from spec_template.

inventory_id.description: Item id from add_inventory_item, get_inventory or search_inventory.

location.description: Currently stored at: where the item is kept now (readable label). Not the shop it was bought from — use acquired_from for that. Unknown stays null.

location_observed_at.description: PHI-1998: ISO timestamp when this storage location was observed (default now on a real move).

nickname.description: Instead of inventory_id: nickname/name/model for exactly one active item (e.g. work laptop); several matches return candidates and change nothing.

past_date.description: Date it left YYYY-MM-DD, default today.

past_details.description: Who it went to, where, why.

past_person_id.description: Contact id of buyer or recipient.

past_reason.description: No longer owned: moves it to Past items. status owned restores it.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

sale_price.description: Price it sold or traded for.

spec_template.description: Typed field set for specs; null clears it.

specs.description: Stable facts by template field. Merge per key; null removes. User/device only, never from a model name. No device/account ids.

state.description: Observation of changing facts (observed_at, source, os/battery…). Merge per key; never changes specs. No device/account ids.

storage_building.description: PHI-1998: optional building within the place.

storage_container.description: PHI-1998: optional container within the room.

storage_location_id.description: PHI-1998: id of an inventory_locations row the owner created.

storage_place.description: PHI-1998: optional place name in the storage hierarchy (place > building > room > container).

storage_room.description: PHI-1998: optional room within the building/place.

subtype_confidence.description: 0-1 if the subtype is a guess.

name: update_inventory_item

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

changed_fields.description: Columns set, and the specs / state keys written.

item.description: Inventory item record. With specs: spec_template, specs, state (a timestamped snapshot), state_freshness and capability_summary.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.

resolved_from.description: PHI-448: present when nickname found the item: the nickname sent and matched_on (nickname, name or model).
